releases.body:
Fixes archiving sessions that contain images or other media.

- Preserves the host's media types in archive generation requests.
- Avoids incorrectly discarding archive jobs when unchanged media is compared against a snapshot.

Full changelog: https://github.com/Trollgeir/lacuna/compare/v0.4.0...v0.4.1

The archive agent now chooses ranges without candidate suggestions upfront. If the selected ranges reduce visible context by less than 20%, a follow-up offers candidate hints; valid selections are retained even if the target remains unmet.

- Validation feedback shares the follow-up when needed.
- Accepts empty responses and JSON enclosed entirely in a Markdown code fence.
- Requires OpenTUI 0.8 or newer.

All 51 tests and type checking pass.

Full changelog: https://github.com/Trollgeir/lacuna/compare/v0.3.1...v0.4.0

Improves archive reliability:

- Validates archive selections and retries malformed or rejected entries with targeted feedback.
- Keeps independently valid summaries when repair fails or times out, leaving rejected material visible.
- Tracks repaired source coverage correctly when replacement ranges split or merge.
- Ensures summaries actually reduce context size.

All 50 tests and type checking pass.

Full changelog: https://github.com/Trollgeir/lacuna/compare/v0.3.0...v0.3.1

Configure a separate archive model and archive-only generation settings with `archiveModel`.

Use `archiveMode: "blocking"` to wait for archiving and cleanup before the next main request—useful for resource-constrained local models. Background execution and main-model inheritance remain the defaults.

Includes safer cancellation handling and a fix for OpenCode reporting an unspecified model variant as `default`.

All 42 tests and type checking pass.

Remove the package-level Node engine restriction that caused OpenCode's Bun runtime to resolve the older 0.2.2 release instead of detecting updates. Node.js 26.4.0 remains the development and CI requirement. OpenCode 2.2.0 compatibility and the compiled-TUI packaging workaround are unchanged.
